tokens.name: forest-ink
tokens.usage: Dominant brand dark: pack bodies, dark sections, headlines and icons on light grounds. Lime and paper text on it both pass 10:1.

tokens.name: lime-voltage
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons, active states, the SHAT wordmark on dark packs. Never as text on light grounds (fails contrast). One lime moment per section.

tokens.name: spruce
tokens.usage: Secondary dark green: the Travel Singles pack and cards inside forest-ink sections.

tokens.name: linen-mist
tokens.usage: Pale green wash: soft bands between white and forest sections, tag fills, hover states.

tokens.name: obsidian
tokens.usage: Maximum-contrast display headlines on white or fog, and the body of the Clutch purse pack (lime on it passes 13:1).

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Body copy on paper and fog (9:1 on white).

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Helper text and secondary lines (5.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: pebble
tokens.usage: Input borders, placeholders and dividers only; 3.6:1 on white, so never body text.

tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: Card surfaces, the Unscented pack body, section dividers.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page canvas, text on forest-ink and spruce.

tokens.name: signal-blue
tokens.usage: Rare supporting accent (e.g. a limited-edition flavour band). Not a status colour.

tokens.name: alarm-red
tokens.usage: Rare supporting accent for a warning-label joke on packs. Not a status colour and never body text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The brand shout. Uppercase, one per section; the SHAT wordmark on packs uses this style scaled up.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Smallest size the display face is used at; below 60px use Inter 700.

styles.name: display-mobile
styles.usage: Replaces display on screens under 640px wide.

styles.name: heading-mobile
styles.usage: Replaces heading under 640px. Smallest size for the display face on phones.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Thick, soft, and very good at keeping secrets.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Dry paper just rearranges things. You deserve a clean break.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Tags and pack claim pills, uppercase.
